historical_reviews.deepseek: The user boundary is reasonable, but its grep does not prove Channel Mode m, address membership, actual failover or service continuity and assumes Linux dmesg on Windows.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly refuses the placeholder address and requires an owner-approved value derived from the current map.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Mirror UCE is a fatal/unrecoverable-error path, whereas this row specifically tests successful failover and normal operation.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Never guess a destructive address; BIOS/memory-mode changes and injection require exact identity, approval, recovery and no retry.

original_test_intent: Configure supported memory mirroring, inject a fault into an address proven to reside in the mirrored range, and demonstrate that memory failover occurs with continued system service, correct slot/failover records and no fault-indicator assertion.
original_method: A qualified FAE/operator applies the approved mirrored DIMM population and BIOS mode, proves `mc.addMap()` and `mc.dimminfo()` report mirrored address ranges and Channel Mode m, selects one authorized address from that captured map, performs a single mirror_failover injection, verifies live workload/health continuity and cross-plane records, then restores or documents the approved memory configuration.
manual_activity: The operator/FAE must configure mirror mode, approve the runtime mapped address, execute one injection, observe both indicators and restore memory settings. The agent must reject the source's bracketed placeholder as non-executable.
required_inputs: Supported mirrored DIMM population/controller topology and capacity expectation
Pre/post BIOS mirror/debug settings and restart requirements
Supported ITP/CScripts build/hash plus addMap/dimminfo/mirror_failover semantics
Exact current-run mirrored address range and one owner-approved aligned address
Continuity workload/health metric, expected BMC/UEFI fields and recovery/restoration plan
safety_requirements: Dedicated idle SUT with backup, stable power, independent console and FAE approval
Preserve logs and exact address-map output before changing state
Verify address alignment and membership in the active mirrored range; never reuse a stale/example address
Perform one bounded injection and stop on map mismatch, missing failover, crash, data-integrity concern or lamp assertion
No automatic retry; restore memory mode only after evidence and integrity checks
agent_execution_scope: Validate captured mirror map/address membership and collect read-only Windows/BMC/UEFI/health evidence
Do not choose an address, change BIOS/memory mode, inject, reset/retry or decide PASS/FAIL
engineer_actions: Approve topology, mirror capacity and controller coverage
Supply package contract and exact runtime address selection/alignment rule
Define failover/normal-operation oracle, BMC/UEFI slot records and indicator applicability
Approve backup, recovery, restoration and final verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The SSH grep is only partial post-event evidence and cannot establish mirror mode, mapped address or actual failover; it conflicts with Windows, omits continuity/UEFI/indicator proof and weakens host trust.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Replace no source content, but treat `0x100004000[mirror range]` as a non-runnable placeholder; an FAE selects one address directly from the captured active map and runs `mirror_failover` once.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Mirror mode, Channel Mode m, controller 1~N and 30/15-minute estimates are preserved; no address is inferred from the example.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture before/after capacity and mirrored map, calculate membership/alignment of the approved address, monitor a bounded continuity workload plus BMC event stream during one injection, retain full Cscript/Windows/UEFI evidence and restore/diff BIOS/memory health.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes the placeholder address and `system should work normally` objectively verifiable without changing the mirror-failover stimulus.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A mirror keyword in logs does not prove failover at the mapped address or continued service; those are the case's defining coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A stale or non-mirrored address may inject outside redundancy, crash Windows or corrupt data; changing mirror mode alters usable capacity/topology.

project_override_considerations: The exact runtime memory address is a material destructive parameter requiring fresh user/FAE confirmation. Missing map or recovery information blocks execution, never justifies a guessed value or DUT failure.
expected_evidence: Supported population, pre/post capacity and BIOS mirror configuration
Package hash, full `mc.addMap()`/`mc.dimminfo()` with Channel Mode m and mirrored ranges
Approved address with demonstrated range/alignment membership and injection transcript
Continuity metrics, BMC failover/UCE slot record, applicable UEFI and off-indicator evidence, restoration/integrity and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: `0x100004000[mirror range]` is not an executable address and cannot be reused without the live map. Controller 1~N lacks a coverage sequence; Windows is paired with dmesg; and indicator/UEFI applicability plus `system should work normally` lack deterministic definitions.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The failover operation and required live-map resolution are understandable. A supported topology, current map, approved address, oracle and recovery are obtainable inputs, so the case is conditionally executable.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row 18 Wistron-System RAS-00738-V003: approve mirrored DIMM/controller topology, capacity and controller 1~N coverage; Intel ITP/CScripts version/hash and addMap/dimminfo/mirror_failover semantics; exact live-map address selection/alignment rule replacing `0x100004000[mirror range]`; deterministic continuity, BMC/UEFI/indicator oracle; Windows evidence source, backup, recovery and configuration restoration.

review_improvement: This review blocks execution of a malformed example address and makes successful redundancy failover and continued service—not a generic memory log—the primary evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: Mirror failover is address-dependent: the injected physical address must belong to the active mirrored region generated by the current population and BIOS settings. The bracketed source text is a placeholder, not a value. Even a correct UCE log is insufficient if the platform crashed or targeted a non-mirrored page; a synchronized workload/health check must show continuity while the mirror-failover record identifies the affected controller/slot. Because the live map, package and oracle can be supplied safely by the FAE, REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION is appropriate rather than BLOCKED.
